messages:
maria: quick sync — i'm consolidating the INC-834 postmortem actions into one matrix. can folks confirm owners and realistic due dates?
kevin: got the list? i can own the infra automation items (A1, A3). target by 2025-04-10 for A1, 2025-04-18 for A3.
samir: i'll take the model-serving regression investigation (A2). aiming EOD 2025-04-08 to have a root-cause hypothesis.
jia: will pick up the monitoring alerts tuning (A4) but need a dependency on kevin's infra change. propose due 2025-04-15 if infra lands by 04-10.
olivia: i'll coordinate docs + runbook updates (A5). can draft by 2025-04-12, final by 2025-04-17.
amy_pm: thanks — please add blockers inline. we need cross-team signoff before canary on 2025-04-20.
oncall-bot: reminder: incident INC-834 has 3 open actions past P0 window. react with :white_check_mark: when you commit a date.
maria: copied below is the matrix i'm assembling — paste small edits or say "ack" to confirm.
```
ActionID | ShortDesc                          | Owner   | DueDate     | DependsOn | Blockers
A1       | rollback automation (infra)        | kevin   | 2025-04-10  | -         | access to infra-staging
A2       | serving regression RCA             | samir   | 2025-04-08  | -         | load repro flakiness
A3       | kv-cache eviction fix              | kevin   | 2025-04-18  | A2        | perf test infra
A4       | alerts threshold tuning            | jia     | 2025-04-15  | A1        | waits on infra deploy
A5       | postmortem runbook + docs         | olivia  | 2025-04-17  | A2,A4     | doc review cycle
```
maria: if you need to shift dates, suggest new date + short reason. i'll update tracker (spreadsheets) and ping legal/ops for access where needed.
kevin: small blocker — need a short-lived svc account for rollback job. @amy_pm can we get approval today?
amy_pm: yes, i'll send a short approval note to infra-ops and cc kevin by noon PST.
samir: for A2, i might need help reproducing the load shape. @jia can you share the perf harness config you used last week?
jia: shared in thread: `perf/configs/serving-smoke.yaml` — i'll DM you the exact seed and traffic profile.
olivia: also, can someone add me to the canary runbook checklist? want to make sure ops steps are clear.
kevin: added olivia on repo perms. olivia: confirmed :white_check_mark:
maria: thanks — final ask: respond with a one-line ack (owner + due) or propose new date. i'll close the loop this afternoon and create the cross-team PR for the canary gates. :slightly_smiling_face:
